result.summary: The page is largely well laid out, with consistent spacing, clear restaurant cards, and a clean bottom navigation bar. The main visual defect is the promo banner, where the white text is nearly unreadable against the pale mint background. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were treated as intended scrolling behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The promo banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white on a very light mint green background. The contrast is far below WCAG minimums, so the offer code and conditions are effectively invisible.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text to a dark color (such as the near-black used for headings or a dark green) or use a darker background behind the white text. Verify the result meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
